command:
set -u
printf 'IDENTITY host=%s user=%s\n' "$(hostname)" "$(id -un)"
before_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
before_enter=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)
printf 'SERVICE_BEFORE pid=%s enter=%s\n' "$before_pid" "$before_enter"
printf 'INSTALLED_CUTOVER_SHA=%s\n' "$(sudo -n sha256sum /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py | awk '{print $1}')"
rc=0
printf 'CUTOVER_INSPECT_BEGIN\n'
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py inspect || rc=$?
printf 'CUTOVER_INSPECT_END rc=%s\n' "$rc"
verify_rc=0
printf 'CUTOVER_VERIFY_BEGIN\n'
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py verify || verify_rc=$?
printf 'CUTOVER_VERIFY_END rc=%s\n' "$verify_rc"
if sudo -n test -f /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; then printf 'MANIFEST_SHA=%s\n' "$(sudo -n sha256sum /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json | awk '{print $1}')"; else printf 'MANIFEST_MISSING=1\n'; fi
printf 'DURABLE_FILES_BEGIN\n'; sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state -maxdepth 5 -type f -printf '%P %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true; printf 'DURABLE_FILES_END\n'
after_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
after_enter=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)
printf 'SERVICE_AFTER pid=%s enter=%s\n' "$after_pid" "$after_enter"
if [[ "$before_pid" != "$after_pid" || "$before_enter" != "$after_enter" ]]; then printf 'RUNTIME_EPOCH_DRIFT=1\n' >&2; exit 97; fi
if (( rc != 0 )); then exit "$rc"; fi
exit "$verify_rc"
